Today, I introduced the Karly Rain Wood Act. In 2022, Karly Rain Wood, a 20-year-old from Omaha, was murdered. Karly Rain’s killer was previously convicted of four different felonies. But he had been released to freely roam our streets.

My bill would create a publicly searchable national registry for repeat violent offenders. Just like with the sex offender registry, Americans would know who is living in their neighborhood. It’s commonsense to keep Nebraska’s streets safe.
